terms.register: vōx plērumque poētica: Verg., Ov., Hor.

terms.gloss: a bringing forth, bearing; what is brought forth: young, offspring, fruit
evidence: Cic. Fin. 3.63: quārum in fētū et in ēducātiōne labōrem cum cernimus (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: velut āles, ab altō quae teneram prōlem prōdūxit in āëra nīdō, hortāturque sequī
phrases.english: like a bird that has led her tender young out of the high nest into the air, and urges them to follow

phrases.latin: quārum in fētū et in ēducātiōne labōrem cum cernimus
phrases.english: when we see the trouble they (the beasts) take in bearing and rearing their young

sources: Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
